PJTSAU crop diagnostics.

A connected mobile and web platform for detecting and diagnosing insect pests and crop diseases. Built in collaboration between Professor Jayashankar Telangana Agricultural University (PJTAU) and K L University, Hyderabad.

Full Stack DevelopmentMobile + WebDigital agricultureCompleted January 2025

A connected workflow for crop care.

My role: Full Stack Development, as part of a seven-member team.

The project links geo-referenced image capture in the field with a centralized, database-driven web dashboard. Its workflow includes automated synchronization, expert validation, case allocation, and secure two-way treatment advisories.

Project period: 25 August 2024 – 25 January 2025. The university’s certificate acknowledges the team’s successful completion of the digital platform and identifies Tadivaka Sathwik’s specialization as Full Stack Development.
